title: Guest
description: Profile of an individual guest staying at the accommodation.

id.description: Stable, opaque session-scoped identifier for a guest in the Platform's namespace.

honorific_prefix.description: Honorific prefix used to address the guest on the reservation and in correspondence. Well-known values: `mr`, `mrs`, `ms`, `mx`, `dr`. Platforms MAY send other values; a Business that does not recognize a value SHOULD address the guest by name only rather than reject the booking. Platforms MUST NOT infer this value from other fields.

phone_number.description: E.164 standard. Phone number of the guest.

age.description: Age of the guest, used to enforce any age-restriction for check-in and accommodation occupancy.

nationality.description: Nationality (citizenship) of the guest as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
